title: Equilibrium Constant Kc Calculation
body: For the reaction: H2(g) + I2(g) <=> 2HI(g), at equilibrium the concentrations are: [H2] = 0.11 mol/dm^3, [I2] = 0.11 mol/dm^3, [HI] = 0.78 mol/dm^3. Calculate the equilibrium constant Kc.
oer: Siyavula Grade 12 Physical Sciences - Chemical Equilibrium
